card.name: Joining words before a second term
card.fires_on: Small joining words or spaces right before a second item in a pair or comparison, such as 'and' in 'gastric and duodenal' or the space before a percentage after 'vs.'. It also fires on a few Spanish words and brand-name pieces.

modes.label: Pair joiner
modes.description: The word 'and' or a space between two paired terms, just before the second one.
modes.example: There have been post-marketing reports of gastric<< and>> duodenal ulcers with oral bis

modes.label: Comparison gap
modes.description: The space after 'vs.' just before the second number in a group comparison.
modes.example: in the 10 mg group (9.2% vs.<< >>2.5%, respectively)

modes.label: Spanish or name pieces
modes.description: A Spanish word or a piece of a brand name inside non-English or label text.

card.plain: It marks the spot where a second half of a pair, like 'gastric and duodenal', is about to come.
